rules.title: Isolytic damage has its own track
rules.description: Isolytic damage scales with total standard damage before enemy standard mitigation. Isolytic defense reduces this parallel track.
rules.formula: Isolytic = standard damage × isolytic bonus / (1 + isolytic defense)
rules.coverage: Implemented for explicit ship/research values and supported active officer abilities. Conditional abilities are disclosed separately.

rules.title: Gorn Hunters resist conventional weapons
rules.description: Gorn Hunters are immune to non-isolytic damage. A standard-damage crew cannot defeat them, regardless of its raw attack.
rules.coverage: Standard immunity is enforced for Gorn Hunter. Other curated Gorn variants are not automatically treated as verified Hunters. Incoming isolytic magnitude must be supplied from the target or battle log.

rules.title: Apex extends effective health
rules.description: Apex divides incoming standard and Isolytic damage once by 1 + points / 10,000. Each additional 10,000 adds one base-health equivalent, rather than repeatedly doubling total health.
rules.coverage: Actual hull and shield pools are tracked separately. Player and enemy Shred reduce their opponent’s barrier; mode-specific exclusions still need calibration.

rules.title: Critical Mitigation uses points
rules.description: The 50,000 denominator matches one published worked example but is not confirmed by that example alone, and later updates rebalance Academy combat.
rules.coverage: Valid sources accumulate in points. Mixed legacy reductions remain explicit compatibility estimates. Current battle logs are required to validate the curve and its Isolytic interaction.

rules.title: The source must match the encounter
rules.description: Remote Campus applies to Academy drones; Matter Beam to PvP; Simulacrum to eligible ships in PvP and Training Drone combat.
rules.coverage: No invented Duo mitigation entry requirement. Typed sources preserve units, contexts and conditions; unreviewed imports cannot silently change global totals.

rules.title: The combat triangle has a direction
rules.description: Interceptors are favored against Battleships; Battleships against Explorers; Explorers against Interceptors.
rules.coverage: The PvP panel provides baseline counter-team guidance. Unsupported strike-team mechanics are disclosed and are not a verified numerical advantage.

rules.title: Captain, bridge and below deck are distinct
rules.description: Captain maneuvers are evaluated in the captain seat, officer abilities on the bridge, and below-deck abilities only below deck. Officers cannot occupy multiple seats.
rules.coverage: All captain placements are searched within a ranked shortlist. The local compiled ability catalogue is not an authoritative rules engine; missing conditions and unsupported effects are disclosed.

rules.title: Buffs are additive within a stat category
rules.description: Like-for-like additive bonuses dilute marginal gains. Raw officer points are converted through ship-specific officer-bonus tables rather than added directly as ship damage or hull.
rules.formula: Marginal gain = new bonus / (1 + existing bonus)
rules.coverage: Imported adjusted officer stats are not buffed twice. Missing ship tables and unknown stat provenance are disclosed. Table interpolation needs live calibration.

rules.title: The live game keeps evolving
rules.description: Toryn and Trelane have sourced records. The Neelix/Harry Kim identity migration is flagged rather than silently assigning progression to another officer.
rules.coverage: Complete status chains, ship passives, coordinated waves, station platforms, hauling and anomaly event state remain outside this model. The interface labels individual encounters accordingly.

rules.title: Exact enemies, levels and IDs
rules.description: No Gorn-to-Actian or generic-wave substitutions. Choose a real family, hull class, level and variant.
rules.coverage: The underlying snapshot is versioned; a correct identity does not guarantee all current special abilities are represented.

rules.title: Triggered and timed abilities
rules.description: Hugh procs once per received weapon attack, with rank-dependent chance and two-round stacks. Selected Seska, Suder and PIC Hugh regeneration and timed effects have separate triggers.
rules.coverage: Weapon schedules accept warmup, cooldown and shot count. Missing schedules use a disclosed aggregate attack. Event timing needs battle-log validation.

rules.title: Synergy and Isolytic Cascade
rules.description: Captain arrays represent base and synergy increments, not promotion levels. Unknown class data cannot establish full synergy. Cascade is distinct from ordinary Isolytic damage.
rules.formula: Combined Isolytic estimate = raw × [I × (1 + C) + C] / (1 + defense)
rules.coverage: The combined Cascade formula is community-derived; conflicting interpretations require calibration.

limitations: Results are partial combat-model outcomes, not live win probabilities. Confidence intervals describe random sampling only, not missing mechanics.
The bounded search and greedy marginal below-deck selection do not prove global optimality. Loot per flight, complete raids, waves and anomaly rewards are not calculated.
Unknown data and unreviewed sources remain explicitly omitted.
